ingrid: FYI — nightly perf run flagged a regression on mixtral7b conversions, looks like the runtime is picking a slower kernel for long-seq workloads and causing KV cache thrash. attaching quick logs and flame output.

ingrid: snippet:
```
[perf] model=mixtral7b artifact=converted_safetensors seq_len=2048 batch=2 kernel=rope-kernel-v2 latency_p95=420ms p50=110ms
kv_cache: misses++ evict_count=78 evict_time=12.3s
```
ingrid: this started after the safetensors conversion script update we rolled yesterday — conversion metadata may be missing a heads/qkv dim field so kernel selector falls back to generic rope kernel. :grimacing:

sam: can you drop the hf_config.json that was used for the conversion? also the exact safetensors header (first ~200 bytes) would help.

ingrid: pasted the hf config we fed into the converter:
```
{"architectures": ["MixtralForCausalLM"], "hidden_size": 4096, "num_hidden_layers": 32, "n_head": 32, "head_dim": 128}
```

alex: aha — runtime kernel selector expects "num_attention_heads" or "num_heads" in HF config for our heuristics. "n_head" is nonstandard; converter should have normalized it. that explains head_dim mismatch at runtime and forces kernel fallback.

maria: iirc the safetensors metadata also had axes order issues previously. if the metadata doesn't advertise 'heads' in the expected key (we check several aliases), kernel selection will prefer the conservative implementation.

sam: quick triage idea: force kernel_override in model manifest to the optimized kernel for this model while we fix converter/parse logic. we can do a Canary on dedicated infra.

alex: agree — kernel_override: "mixtral-optimized-v1" should restore p95 to ~120ms in my local smoke tests. but we need to add schema validation in the conversion step so this doesn't regress again.

ingrid: i ran a quick local with override, p95 dropped to 128ms, kv_eviction went to zero. paste of local run:
```
./run_infer --model converted_safetensors --kernel mixtral-optimized-v1 --seq 2048 --batch 2
result: p50=105ms p95=128ms kv_evictions=0
```

ci-bot: perf-job/4821 triggered by ingrid — status: failed (baseline mismatch). See CI link: https://ci.internal/jobs/4821 :x:

maria: i can push a small change to converter to normalize fields: accept aliases ["n_head","num_heads","num_attention_heads","heads"] and write canonical "num_attention_heads" into safetensors metadata and hf_config. i'll add unit tests for roundtrip.

sam: also add a validation check in runtime at model onboarding to warn (and optionally reject) if head*head_dim != hidden_size. that would catch head/dim misconfigs before serving.

alex: +1. low friction short-term: manifest kernel_override + canary; medium-term: converter PR + onboarding validation; long-term: add a parser fuzzer to CI that mutates hf keys and verifies kernel selection determinism.

devops-bot: canary deploy queued (dedicated-us-west-2, pool=canary) — ETA ~8m.

ingrid: i've opened infra ticket RW-1258 and converter PR draft at https://git.internal/rw/mixtral-converter/pulls/21. assigning to maria for the parser changes. i'll monitor canary once deployed. :eyes:

maria: taking RW-1258 and PR-21, will push converter fix + tests today. adding onboarding schema check as a follow-up (RW-1259).

sam: thanks — once canary looks good, we should roll kernel_override to prod in a controlled rollback window.

ingrid: will post perf diffs here after canary finishes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
